versions.changelog:
huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.7.13

- Fixed infinite loop on large-file-bridge upload URL: now only injects the upload link once per session (adds replyAppendUsed marker).
- Improved prompt guidance: after user uploads, AI is instructed to call enhance_upload_check({token}) to process files, not to re-send upload links or ask follow-up questions.
- Clarified file upload post-processing steps to ensure smooth workflow and prevent repeated prompts.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.7.12

- large-file-bridge now auto-generates a unique token URL for uploads when triggered (to support models that ignore prompts).
- Upon before_prompt_build, creates a 12-character hex token using randomBytes(6), storing it in injectedSessions, and writes it to manifest.json (shared with bot-upload-link).
- The generated URL (/plugins/enhance-upload/<token>) is consistent before and after agent reply; fallback logic ensures the token URL is always appended to LLM output if needed.
- enhance_upload_check can be used to view the list of current tokens/files, ensuring discoverability regardless of model compliance.
- Robust fallback guarantees users always receive a valid upload link, even with zero-prompt-following weak models.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.7.11

- Strengthened dual-layer prompt-following for large-file-bridge to prevent LLMs (like MiniMax M2.7) from ignoring directives and reverse-engineering code limits.
- Prompt improved to a strict command: the reply must copy a given segment verbatim, forbidding exec, questioning, or configuration changes.
- Bottom-layer regex detection now only matches true upload links, no longer triggers on descriptive text containing "upload".
- Fixes cases where the safeguard in before_agent_reply misjudged regular narrative replies as having issued upload links.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.7.10 重点修复与优化 large-file-bridge 的触发机制：

- 放宽 large-file-bridge 触发条件：不再仅限 agentId.startsWith('wecom-')，企微“视频/文件超过 100M,无法下载”等错误文本命中即可触发。
- now allows large-file-bridge in main agent/terminal/cli 等场景，覆盖更多实际 LLM 文件上传提示场景。
- 主动“要传大文件”引导仍限定 wecom- agent，不影响原逻辑。
- 继承 v6.7.9 的 baseUrl 多源解析、v6.7.8 的 /plugins/enhance/* 统一及 token 化追踪链路。
- 持续保证“非侵入式增强”，不改动 OpenClaw 核心或复制原生功能。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.7.9 — 修复 large-file-bridge 上传链接缺公网前缀的问题

- 修正 large-file-bridge 返回的上传链接 baseUrl 解析，避免 LLM 收到的链接只有裸路径（如 /plugins/enhance/upload）缺少 https://公网前缀
- 链接拼接升级为 bot-share-link/bot-upload-link 同款优先级链（环境变量 BOT_BASE_URL > config.baseUrl > 配置文件 > 桥服务自动检测），全场景保证上传链接为公网可访问
- 继承 v6.7.8 路径统一与 token 化上传追踪机制
- 其他功能和用法保持不变

- 上传入口统一为 /plugins/enhance/upload 和 /plugins/enhance-upload/<token>，删除所有 /lanhuo/upload 与 /upload 短链支持
- AI/LLM 调用上传能力时，优先使用带 token 的链接，通过 enhance_upload_check 可追踪具体上传内容
- 共享上传 URL 只做浏览器 fallback，增强安全与可追踪性
- 修改提示和前端逻辑，适配新的上传路径与 token 使用模式

- 修复 /upload 路径与 OpenClaw control UI SPA 冲突，默认回退到 /lanhuo/upload 以确保正常上传
- 更新提示文案，明确告知 /upload 不可用，需使用 /lanhuo/upload
- 保持 /lanhuo/upload 及 /plugins/enhance/upload 的兼容 alias
- 继承此前版本的大文件流式上传（2GB 不 OOM）能力

v6.7.6 — 上传 URL 支持简化：keepermac.huo15.com/upload 直达上传页。

- 默认上传 URL 简化为最短 /upload，用户可直接访问 keepermac.huo15.com/upload 上传文件
- 提示文案与 LLM 引导统一修改为 /upload，便于用户理解和使用
- large-file-bridge 和 cc-bridge-prompt 相关上传路径均调整为 /upload
- 继续兼容历史 alias：/lanhuo/upload、/plugins/enhance/upload 均可使用
- 继承 v6.7.5 的 2GB 单文件流式上传，不会导致内存溢出

- 上传支持提升：单文件最大上传体积扩展到 2GB，并通过流式写盘方式处理，避免 OOM。
- handleUpload 新增 octet-stream + X-Filename header 支持，stream 直写本地文件，超 2GB 自动中断并清理残留。
- 旧 multipart/form-data 上传路径保留，但加 100MB 上限防内存溢出。
- 上传页面 UPLOAD_HTML 改为二进制流 xhr.send(file)，显示实时进度（MB/GB/百分比）、同源路径兼容 nginx 反代。
- large-file-bridge prompt 更新说明“2GB 以内都可上传”。
- 继承 v6.7.4 的 URL 修复和 /lanhuo/upload 别名。

- 修复 large-file-bridge 上传链接推送 URL 错位问题，确保用户总是收到 /lanhuo/upload 链接。
- dashboard 新增 /lanhuo prefix，/lanhuo/upload 作为上传入口，区分与普通仪表盘页面，prompt 也明确区分上传与任务功能。
- 补全 v6.7.2/3 的 before_agent_reply hook 注册，保持 git 与 npm 包同步。
- release.sh 新增第 12 项预检：描述里提到的 hook 名必须在 src/ 注册，防止描述与实际代码不一致。
- 继承此前增强的 prompt 强引导、agentId 前缀 channel 检测、model-id 大小写校验和全模块 hook 防御机制。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.6.9

- config-doctor now checks for model-id case sensitivity: catches config issues where agent model IDs don't exactly match any provider (e.g. "DeepSeek-V4-Pro" vs "deepseek-v4-pro"), which previously caused "Something went wrong" errors on first LLM call.
- Adds startup validation for all agent default and fallback model IDs; gives precise fix command if only a case mismatch, and suggests registration if model is missing entirely.
- Inherits previous version’s full safeHook defense (try/catch wrapping all module hooks) and user-config override.
- No core OpenClaw logic is modified; continues non-intrusive enhancement.

**v6.6.8 introduces comprehensive safety wrapping for all plugin hooks**

- Systematically applies try/catch protection to all 28 plugin hooks across 17 modules using a Proxy wrapper for api.on(), not just ctx-watchdog's 6 hooks.
- Prevents crashes from unhandled exceptions in any hook (e.g. model-router, session-lifecycle, session-bridge, etc.), addressing "Something went wrong" errors.
- All hook exceptions are logged, and the main workflow continues unaffected.
- Inherits user-config-priority model selection and providerOverride logic from previous versions.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.6.7

- Escalation model candidates now read from user's openclaw.json config, not hardcoded.
- Adds readUserAgentModels to detect real user model setup (primary, fallbacks, providers) and true contextWindow/cost.
- pickEscalateTargetFromUserConfig selects targets strictly by available user config and context size.
- All context escalation and status logic (before_model_resolve, enhance_route_to_long_ctx, enhance_ctx_status) now prioritize user config, using static fallback only as a last resort.
- Keeps previous v6.6.6 safeHook protections and earlier enhancements (providerOverride, runId dedupe, cost-aware logic, multimodal/accounting, channel differences).

v6.6.6 (ctx-watchdog 全面 harden)

- 所有 ctx-watchdog 相关 hook（共 7 个：llm_output、llm_input、subagent_spawned、subagent_ended、after_compaction、before_prompt_build、before_model_resolve）全部用 safeHook() try/catch 包裹，异常安全防护。
- 任一 hook handler 内部异常不再影响主流程，错误直接 log，主流程继续。
- readInstalledProviders now independently try/catch，防止因 api.runtime 不存在导致插件崩溃。
- 解决 v6.6.5 及之前版本偶发 “Something went wrong” 崩溃问题。
- 继承 v6.6.4 跨 provider 强切 bug 修正与多项稳定性增强。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.6.5

- 修复长上下文模型强制切换时 provider 指定错误，确保 providerOverride 与 modelOverride 同步返回，实现三重过滤并反查用户实际已注册的 provider（v6.6.4）。
- 优化 cc-bridge-prompt，普通对话消息不再自动附加 dashboard 链接，避免多余的 /lanhuo URL 注入（v6.6.3）。
- 继承 v6.6.2 的 runId 去重与 enhance_ctx_silence 功能，持续提升上下文守护稳定性。
- CI 文档同步、代码热修复以及 dashboard 链接误注问题闭环修正。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.6.2

- 修复 llm_output retry 情况下的重复累加 bug：增加 seenRunIds Set（20 项 FIFO），同 runId 的多次 emit 仅计入一次，避免 model-fallback 二次计费。
- 新增 enhance_ctx_silence 工具（参数：minutes 1-60, reason 可选）；开启后所有 banner 通知静音，自动按时解除。
- 继承 v6.6.0 版本的 cost-aware、多模态精算、channel 差异化等增强特性。

v6.6.0 introduces advanced cost awareness, multi-modal precision, and channel-specific thresholds for OpenClaw context management:

- Adds cost-aware context tracking: maintains real-time LLM model price sheets (18 models), estimates cumulative usage cost (USD), and warns when monthly budget exceeds 80%.
- Supports multimodal precision: images are counted as 800-1500 context tokens per piece, tuned per model (Gemini 800 / GPT 1200 / Claude 1500).
- Implements channel-specific thresholds: distinct warn/limit levels for group chat (60/75/90%), direct (65/80/92%), and terminal (70/85/95%); WeCom auto-detects group/direct.
- Maintains all prior features: subagent context accumulation, predictive warnings, and persistent context tracking.
- File updates: major logic in context watchdog/types and context DB utilities.

v6.5.7 improves context guard logic for multi-agent scenarios and predictive warnings.

- Tracks subagent token usage: child agent token counts now accumulate to parent agent after subagent ends, fixing context tracking blind spot in multi-agent workflows.
- Predictive overload warning: uses tokensPerTurnHistory of last 5 rounds to forecast when the context will hit warnAt threshold, pushing reminders earlier.
- Cleans up outdated sidus-specific hardcoded logic.
- All prior context persistence and revert-to-original features are retained.

v6.5.6 introduces persistent context usage tracking and automated model revert to optimize costs.

- Context usage is now stored in a sqlite ctx_usage table (schema v7), persisting data across restarts with 10s throttled flush and 30-day TTL cleanup.
- After context compaction, if context falls below 60%, the system auto-suggests reverting to the original (non-long-ctx) model.
- New tools: enhance_route_revert_to_original and enhance_ctx_profile for model management and context profiling.
- Fully inherits v6.5.5's long-context auto-switching and pre-estimation, v6.5.4's 3-stage banner alerts, and prior enhancements.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.5.5 — 实现上下文守护的真实闭环自动切换 long-ctx 模型

- 新增 before_model_resolve hook（priority=100）：会话累计 token ≥95% 时自动改用超长上下文模型（如 claude-opus-4.7-1m、gemini-2.5-pro、kimi-k2，跳过被禁模型），实现无需 LLM 主动决策即可强制切换
- 新增 enhance_route_to_long_ctx 工具：允许 LLM 在上下文占用≥80%时主动请求切换到 long-ctx 模型
- 支持事前 prompt 估算 pendingTokens（按4字符/1token＋图片1500 token计），提前预警即将溢出
- 升级为真正“闭环”守护：v6.5.4 仅 banner 提醒，v6.5.5 能绕过 LLM 自动调高模型

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.5.4 — 新增上下文守护（Context Watchdog），提前预警 token 超标，协助主动切换大 context 模型。

- 新增会话级 token 累加机制，分三档预警（70%/85%/95%）。
- 达到 80% 时主动建议切换更大 context 的模型。
- 新增 enhance_ctx_status 工具，支持 LLM 主动查询上下文状态。
- 支持在溢出错误爆发前预警，提升会话稳定性，与原生 overflow fallback 互补。
- after_compaction 自动归零，每轮基于 llm_output 统计 token 使用。

Version 6.5.3

- Added context-watchdog module for enhanced reliability and context management.
- Updated core types and internal interfaces.
- Improved context and session stability across modules.
- Refined package metadata and dependency versions.
- General code maintenance for improved robustness and clarity.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.5.2

- 新增 BOT 文件上传桥（bot-upload-link），支持 LLM 提供上传链接，用户浏览器可上传任意 ≤2GB 文件，并可拉取文件清单，无需新 npm 依赖。
- 新增 cc-bridge-keyword-dispatch，支持蓝火智能体关键词触发，用户输入关键词即可 HTTP POST 真正触发任务，绕开 LLM 决策。
- 优化 session-bridge，修复群聊场景跨夜失忆问题，多字段回填，chat_id 支持 null fallback。
- 新增 large-file-bridge 模块，与 bot-share-link 共享 baseUrl 配置。
- 兼容继承 v6.2.1 及之前的 token 优化、三层守卫与智能路由功能。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.4.2

- Added new modules: `cc-bridge-dispatch-harness` and `cc-bridge-pre-fetch` for enhanced pre-fetching and dispatch integration.
- Updated multiple core files to support the new bridge modules and overall architecture improvements.
- Extended or adjusted types in `src/types.ts` to enable new capabilities.
- Improved internal session bridge logic for better memory and tool handling.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.2.1

- Reduced memory supplement prompt token usage from 500 to 150 tokens per call, keeping all 5 scenario enums and criteria for LLM guidance.
- Significantly cuts monthly token cost for this feature (est. ~$52 → ~$16) with no loss of function.
- All functionalities from v6.2.0 and prior are preserved.

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.2.0

- 强化第二天失忆防护：memory-integrator 模块升级，prompt supplement 明确引导 LLM 主动调 enhance_memory_store（覆盖 5 大类典型场景，含判据与 anti-pattern）。
- session-bridge 注入增强：在上下文添加 PRIOR_SESSION_CHECKPOINT banner，并附完整跨夜 jsonl 路径，鼓励 LLM 主动读取历史确保会话连续性。
- 继承 v6.1.9 session-bridge 3 倍扩容与 surfacer 松绑等核心增强。
- 无侵入修改，仅提升 OpenClaw 超长 session/隔夜场景下的记忆可靠性。

v6.1.9 addresses "second-day amnesia" and improves file surfacing:

- Session-bridge window expanded (messages: 8→20, size: 4KB→12KB, time: 48h→72h) to better retain cross-day context history.
- Native-memory-surfacer relaxed: max surfaced files 5→12, relevance threshold 0.15→0.05, and new cwdBoost/ageBoost for higher recall. Now user/reference .md files can surface more reliably.
- No changes to native core or duplication of OpenClaw builtin features.
- Retains previous enhancements: bot-share routing, capability checks, quota awareness, cc-bridge prompts, dynamic routing, and more.

# v6.1.8

- bot-share 文件分发策略调整：小文件优先走渠道本地直发（如 wecom MEDIA:），大文件才走 enhance_share_file 链接。
- 新增本地直发/链接分流决策表和用户偏好覆盖支持。
- 更正 v6.1.3 以来的强制 share_file 策略，适配最新版 wecom 通道和 UI 后恢复直发优先。
- 保持非侵入式增强，继承以往版本的 pickModel capability 验证与 quota-aware 路由等特性。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.1.7

- 修复 model-router 路由能力覆盖问题：selectProvider 返回值现在会过 capability 验证，解决 image 路由被死 entry 覆盖导致能力失效的事故。
- 保持 v6.1.6 新增的 quota-aware 路由切换机制：遇到 HTTP 422/429/402 或 "额度超限/quota exceeded" 类硬错误，立即 ban 1h，下次自动选同模态/同 reasoning 的备选 provider。
- 其他功能、API 兼容未变。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.1.6

- 新增 model-router "quota-aware" 智能切换：遇到 HTTP 422/429/402 或 "额度超限/quota exceeded" 等硬错误时立即 ban 当前路由 1 小时，不等错误率累积。
- 下次路由会自动选择相同模态/推理能力的备选模型，减少中断。
- 新增工具：enhance_model_route_ban_status（查看 ban 状态）与 enhance_model_route_unban（手动解除 ban）。
- 继续继承蓝火 dashboard 引导（v6.1.5）、动态智能路由与 cost-budget 支持等功能。

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.1.5

- 新增模块：引入 src/modules/cc-bridge-prompt.ts。
- 多处核心文件优化和更新（index.ts, src/types.ts 等）。
- package.json 和文档同步版本至 6.1.5。

**Summary: Major model-router upgrade.**

- model-router module refactored to auto-read openclaw.json at startup, building a live capabilities table (add models via config, no code changes)
- Supports image routing, context-aware long-context prioritization, channel-sensitive fallback (IM prefers fast flash models), and circuit breaker (routes around models with >50% error rate)
- Adds cost-budget mode for better model selection based on expected spend
- Zero IO on hook call path: does not slow down first-token latency
- Inherits all features from 6.1.3 (bot-share strict file limits) and previous releases (25+ capability modules)

huo15-huo15-openclaw-enhance v6.1.1

- Improved: Session doctor module further enhances session health checks and lifecycle management.
- Improved: Trajectory archiver enhancements for session/agent state tracking.
- Docs: Updated CHANGELOG.md, README.md, and SKILL.md to reflect changes and clarify usage.
- Manifest and config updates for better compatibility and documentation alignment.
- Minor internal refactoring for maintainability.

Major update with npm package rename for alignment and manifest issue resolution.

- Package renamed: `@huo15/openclaw-enhance` → `@huo15/huo15-openclaw-enhance` to follow naming convention and enable clean ClawHub plugin entry (fixes ghost manifest issues from bare pluginApi slugs 1.3.0–5.1.0).
- Installation: now use `openclaw plugins install @huo15/huo15-openclaw-enhance`.
- OpenClaw plugin id remains `enhance`; upgrade automatically replaces old record without requiring config migration.
- Inherits all capabilities from 5.8.x: classified memory, tool safety, chapters, workflows, statusline, session-bridge, dashboard, file share, native memory surface, model router, and more (25+ modules).
- Use case unchanged: seamlessly enhances OpenClaw without altering core functions or duplicating built-ins.
